name: temu-product-analytics
description: Temu 商品每日流量数据本地分析系统

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @temu-analytics/server" "npm run dev -w @temu-analytics/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @temu-analytics/shared && npm run build -w @temu-analytics/server && npm run build -w @temu-analytics/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @temu-analytics/shared && npm run typecheck -w @temu-analytics/server && npm run typecheck -w @temu-analytics/web
